title: C++: RAII (Resource Acquisition)
description: Implement a RAII wrapper for a simulated resource (file handle).

steps.title: RAII File Handle
steps.description: Create a `FileHandle` class that acquires a resource in the constructor and releases it in the destructor. Track the resource with a static counter. Create and destroy FileHandle objects and print the resource count.
hints: Constructor allocates resource, destructor frees it.
Copy constructor and copy assignment should handle deep copy or be deleted.
Use Rule of Three: destructor, copy constructor, copy assignment.

verification.failureMessage: Create and destroy RAII objects, count should return to 1
